🌍 Pezeshkian pays tribute to martyred Leader, former president, prominent Shia cleric

📌 Tehran, IRNA – President Masoud Pezeshkian has paid tribute to the martyred Leader, former president, and a prominent Shia religious authority during his visit to Khorasan Razavi.

Upon arriving in Khorasan Razavi Province and launching his provincial visit on Tuesday, Pezeshkian visited the holy shrine of Imam Reza (AS) and paid tribute to the martyred Leader of the Islamic Revolution, Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Khamenei, by reciting prayers at his resting place.
​
Ayatollah Khamenei was assassinated in Tehran on February 28, 2026, when the United States and the Israeli terrorist regimes launched acts of aggression against the Islamic Republic of Iran.
​
He also visited the resting places of the late President Ayatollah Seyyed Ebrahim Raisi and Ayatollah Vahid Khorasani, paying his respects and reciting prayers.
​
Raisi and his entourage were martyred on May 20, 2024, when their helicopter crashed en route to Tehran from Tabriz, where the late president was to inaugurate a water project.
​
Grand Ayatollah Hossein Vahid Khorasani , a leading Shia source of emulation and prominent Islamic jurist, passed away on November 17, 2026.
